title: Fix inability to add inventory products (authorization + validation)

requirements.text: Fix backend authorization so authenticated users can create inventory products successfully, even when access control has not been explicitly initialized with an admin secret token.

quotes: REVISA LA PROGRAMACION, NO ME DEJA AGREGAR PRODUCTOS

acceptanceCriteria: When a user is logged in with Internet Identity, calling createInventoryItem no longer traps with an authorization error in a fresh deployment/state.
Anonymous callers (not logged in) are still blocked from creating inventory items (must fail with a clear error).
The change does not grant admin-only capabilities (e.g., createCustomer, addCashboxEntry) to non-admin users.

requirements.text: Add backend-side input validation and clearer trap messages for inventory item creation so the UI can surface actionable errors (e.g., missing required fields, invalid numeric values).

quotes: REVISA LA PROGRAMACION, NO ME DEJA AGREGAR PRODUCTOS

acceptanceCriteria: If description/category are empty (or contain only whitespace), createInventoryItem fails with a clear, specific error message.
If any required numeric field is NaN/invalid (profitMarginPercent, costUsd, sell*Usd), createInventoryItem fails with a clear, specific error message.
If stockCurrent/stockMin are invalid, createInventoryItem fails with a clear, specific error message.

requirements.text: Ensure the frontend inventory create flow surfaces backend errors clearly when product creation fails, and prevents obviously invalid submissions (e.g., empty required fields or non-numeric values) before calling the backend.

quotes: REVISA LA PROGRAMACION, NO ME DEJA AGREGAR PRODUCTOS

acceptanceCriteria: If product creation fails, the toast shows an English error message that includes the backend error reason (not a generic failure only).
The create button is disabled (or submission is blocked) when required numeric inputs cannot be parsed into valid numbers.
After a successful create, the inventory list refreshes and the new product appears without a manual reload.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Implementing new modules unrelated to product creation (e.g., taxes, suppliers, closures) unless required to unblock product creation.
Adding third-party authentication or any non–Internet Identity auth mechanism.
Introducing external databases or non-Motoko backend components.
